facts.text: The hotel is a well-preserved warehouse from the 1800s at the end of Nyhavn.
facts.excerpt: At the end of the colorful Nyhavn, you will find 71 Nyhavn Hotel; a well-preserved warehouse from the 1800s that exudes understated elegance, charm, and history.

facts.text: Merchant Ole Bernt and Captain Just Ludvigsen built the warehouse, completed in 1805.
facts.excerpt: Merchant Ole Bernt and Captain Just Ludvigsen started construction of the warehouse, which was completed in 1805.

facts.text: Alf Arp-Hansen bought the warehouse in 1970 and opened it as a hotel in 1971.
facts.excerpt: Nyhavn 71 remained in their ownership until 1970 when it was sold to Alf Arp-Hansen. He saw the opportunity to transform the beautiful warehouse into a hotel, and in 1971 he opened the doors for the first guests.

facts.text: Guests wake up beneath grained beams of Pomeranian pinewood in the preserved buildings.
facts.excerpt: wake up beneath grained beams of Pomeranian pinewood that runs, side by side, in our preserved buildings

facts.text: Rooms and suites are placed in The Yellow Warehouse and The Red Warehouse.
facts.excerpt: placed in The Yellow Warehouse and The Red Warehouse

facts.text: Breakfast is included with every room choice.
facts.excerpt: No matter what you choose, you get a breakfast included with your stay.

facts.text: The hotel's art collection is based on the European avant-garde movement COBRA.
facts.excerpt: The art collection of the hotel is based on the European avant-garde movement COBRA, which was formed in 1948 in Paris.

facts.text: Asger Jorn's paintings Marche Orange and Compositio can be seen at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: On 71 Nyhavn Hotel you can see Jorn’s well-known paintings, "Marche Orange" and "Compositio".

facts.text: Founder Alf Arp-Hansen made six paintings specifically for the hotel.
facts.excerpt: He made six paintings specifically for the hotel, and these can be experienced up close.

facts.text: The Suite Deluxe View has French glass doors with a view of the harbour life and The Inner Harbour Bridge.
facts.excerpt: The French glass doors in the suite invites plenty inflows of light inside and offer you a view of the vivid harbour life and The Inner Harbour Bridge that connects the city area with Christianshavn.

facts.text: The Suite Deluxe View has a private entrance giving access to two separate rooms, each with a Carpe Diem double bed.
facts.excerpt: private entrance that give you access to two separate rooms, which both are furnished with a double bed from the luxury brand Carpe Diem

facts.text: Junior Suites are set across two levels connected by a spiral staircase.
facts.excerpt: Each suite is individually designed across two levels, connected by a spiral staircase

facts.text: Executive Double Deluxe View rooms are on the south side of The Red Warehouse, looking over the harbour or Nyhavn's fishing boats.
facts.excerpt: placed on the sun-blessed south side in The Red Warehouse and, therefore, offer you a direct view of either the wide harbour or the city life and tied fishing boats in Nyhavn

facts.text: Junior Suites Deluxe on the 6th floor have slanted ceilings and a sofa bed, suited to small families.
facts.excerpt: These rooms are also ideal for small families, as they are furnished with a comfortable sofa bed.

facts.text: Executive Rooms and Executive Double Deluxe rooms look onto the opposite warehouse rather than the water.
facts.excerpt: Our Executive Rooms, which have a view of the opposite warehouse, are the ideal choice for you, if you are looking for our most price-friendly room category.

facts.text: In Junior Suites the bathroom is always on the lower level and may be separated from the sleeping area by a spiral staircase.
facts.excerpt: The bathroom is always located on the lower level and may therefore be separated from the sleeping area by a spiral staircase.

facts.text: Breakfast is served in the historic warehouse cellar.
facts.excerpt: start your day with breakfast in our historic warehouse cellar

facts.text: The restaurant and bar Il Molo serves Italian flavours.
facts.excerpt: Our cozy restaurant and bar, Il Molo, offers an exquisite dining experience with a menu filled with the delicious flavors of Italy.

facts.text: The concierge team assists with everything from dog sitting and transfers to recommendations.
facts.excerpt: Our concierge team welcomes you and assists you with everything from dog sitting and transfers to recommendations for the city's best experiences.

facts.text: Guests can rent a bike from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Experience Copenhagen on two wheels. Rent a bike from us.

facts.text: There is a pillow menu.
facts.excerpt: Pillow menu (contact the reception to learn about the selection of different pillows)

facts.text: Kongens Nytorv is a neighbour and the Royal Theatre is around the corner.
facts.excerpt: With Kongens Nytorv as a neighbor, the Royal Theatre around the corner, and the shopping street Strøget nearby, there is plenty to explore.

facts.text: Amalienborg Palace, Kastellet and the Little Mermaid can be reached on a walk along the harbour front.
facts.excerpt: Take a historical journey along the harbor front, stroll past the majestic Amalienborg Palace, experience Northern Europe's best-preserved fortification Kastellet, and end your tour at the Little Mermaid.

facts.text: The hotel has a limited number of parking spaces behind the hotel, with a public garage close by.
facts.excerpt: 71 Nyhavn Hotel has a limited number of parking spaces behind the hotel, but it is also possible to park in a public parking garage close by.

facts.text: Rooms were gently restored with a focus on a timeless Scandinavian expression while preserving the buildings' historic soul.
facts.excerpt: A restoration with focus on a timeless Scandinavian expression and at the same time preserving the historic soul and charm of the buildings.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome: a hotel stay with a dog is offered.
facts.excerpt: Hotel stay with a dog

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the best address in Copenhagen.
facts.excerpt: Stay at the best address in Copenhagen
